checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'technical-seo'.

checks.description: Audit covers crawlability, speed, indexation, sitemaps, hreflang, RTL, and canonicalization.
checks.rule: Body names crawlability, speed, indexation, sitemaps, hreflang, RTL correctness, and canonicalization.

checks.description: Hreflang is verified for ar and en, reciprocal and correctly coded.
checks.rule: Body verifies ar and en alternates per page, reciprocity confirmed, with correct language and region codes.

checks.description: RTL rendering is verified, including mixed AR, EN, and numerals.
checks.rule: Body checks Arabic pages render right-to-left and mixed content with numerals does not break direction.

checks.description: Concrete Core Web Vitals thresholds are stated for the speed audit.
checks.rule: Body and template state LCP at or under 2.5s, INP at or under 200ms, CLS at or under 0.1 at the 75th percentile, and note INP has replaced FID.

checks.description: Indexation baseline and gap heuristic are stated.
checks.rule: Body states the index,follow plus self-canonical plus 200 baseline, sitemaps carry only canonical 200 URLs, and an indexed-versus-canonical gap above roughly 30 percent is investigated on a quarterly cadence.

checks.description: Each finding carries a severity and a concrete fix.
checks.rule: Output findings[] include area, issue, severity (high|medium|low), affected_urls[], and fix.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: No assumed findings, missing access flagged as open items.
checks.rule: Body states findings are verified not assumed, and missing access or data is flagged as an open item rather than guessed.

checks.description: No crawl or speed tool is adopted without approval.
checks.rule: Body states a crawl or speed tool is not adopted or wired without approval, per CLAUDE.md principle 3.
